ground_truth_viewpoints.label: Conditional positive effect
ground_truth_viewpoints.description: Homework improves achievement for grades 7-12 (d~0.30); near-zero for primary grades.

ground_truth_viewpoints.label: Null meta-analytic effect
ground_truth_viewpoints.description: No significant overall effect when controlling for SES and teacher quality.

ground_truth_viewpoints.label: Wellbeing harm
ground_truth_viewpoints.description: High homework loads correlate with stress and reduced wellbeing.

query: Does homework in primary school benefit young learners?

ground_truth_viewpoints.label: No benefit under age 10
ground_truth_viewpoints.description: Meta-analyses consistently find zero or negative effects for primary-grade homework.

ground_truth_viewpoints.label: Skill-building benefit for specific subjects
ground_truth_viewpoints.description: Narrow math practice homework shows small positive effects at grade 3+.

query: Do statins prevent cardiovascular events in primary prevention patients?

ground_truth_viewpoints.label: Benefit confirmed for high-risk
ground_truth_viewpoints.description: Statins reduce MACE by ~25% relative risk in high-risk primary prevention populations.

ground_truth_viewpoints.label: Marginal benefit with adverse-effect trade-off
ground_truth_viewpoints.description: NNT >200 for low-risk patients; myopathy and diabetes risk may outweigh benefit.

ground_truth_viewpoints.label: Industry-bias concern
ground_truth_viewpoints.description: Industry-funded trials show systematically larger effect sizes than independent trials.

query: Does raising the minimum wage reduce employment?

ground_truth_viewpoints.label: Minimal aggregate effect
ground_truth_viewpoints.description: Card-Krueger-style difference-in-difference studies find near-zero aggregate employment effects.

ground_truth_viewpoints.label: Significant sectoral job losses
ground_truth_viewpoints.description: Low-wage sectors (fast food, retail) show measurable employment reductions.

ground_truth_viewpoints.label: Positive demand-side effect
ground_truth_viewpoints.description: Higher wages increase consumer spending, boosting employment.

query: Does saturated fat increase cardiovascular disease risk?

ground_truth_viewpoints.label: Strong causal link via LDL
ground_truth_viewpoints.description: Saturated fat raises LDL-C, which causally increases CVD risk per Mendelian randomization.

ground_truth_viewpoints.label: Replacement food matters more than SFA per se
ground_truth_viewpoints.description: Replacing SFA with refined carbohydrates does not reduce CVD; replacing with PUFA does.

ground_truth_viewpoints.label: Weak or null effect after confounding adjustment
ground_truth_viewpoints.description: Prospective cohort studies with full dietary adjustment find attenuated or null SFA-CVD associations.
